name: @intentius/tsad-conformance
description: The conformance suite of the typescript-as-data specification: fixture loader, runner, and the named hosts. An implementation supplies an adapter and gets a report.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist fixtures spec && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R ../../spec/fixtures fixtures && mkdir spec && cp ../../spec/VERSION ../../spec/grammar.md ../../spec/judgments.md ../../spec/values.md ../../spec/divergence.md ../../spec/hosts.md ../../spec/rules.md spec/
